run.notes: Latent surface for 180 pair(s): per-window pooled target-encoder embedding (stride=2), shared-PCA trajectory, effective-rank and latent-velocity-vs-pixel-flow rails, and matched possible/impossible divergence against a WITHIN-SCENE null (same-scene, same-validity pairs). The cross-scene derangement band is kept only for contrast (it measures scene identity, not physics). Divergence, velocity and rank are raw-space; PCA is the 2D picture only.

latent_space.metric: L2 between per-window pooled target-encoder embeddings (raw space)
latent_space.cross_scene_note: scene-identity baseline; matched pairs sit far below it by construction

delta_analysis.reduction: mean over windows of (impossible − possible), unit-normalized, full dim
